profile.summary: Finance and accounting leader with 15+ years of progressive experience spanning cost accounting, financial management, and operational oversight. Demonstrates expertise in SAP and ERP system implementations, financial reporting, internal controls (SOX/JSOX compliance), and supply chain management across multi-plant manufacturing environments. Skilled at restructuring accounting departments, streamlining intercompany reconciliation processes, and driving process improvements through Lean Manufacturing and business process optimization. Proven ability to manage teams, implement organizational change, and deliver accurate financial analysis and forecasting under tight deadlines.
